issues.description: ArrayHelpers method name mismatch: The template defines a generic method named appendElement(T[] array, T element) in ArrayHelpers, but the template's Stock.addToStockIngredients calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). The solution repository defines the method as addElementToArray(...). This naming inconsistency between the ArrayHelpers implementation (appendElement) and its usage (addElementToArray) causes a compilation error and prevents students from building the project.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent. Prefer aligning the template with the solution: rename the method in template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java from appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) (matching the signature and behavior used in Stock.addToStockIngredients and the solution). Alternatively, change template/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java to call ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) but aligning with the solution (addElementToArray) is recommended to avoid further confusion.

issues.description: The ArrayHelpers helper method for adding an element to an array is named inconsistently across artifacts. In the template ArrayHelpers (src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java) the method is declared as appendElement(T[] array, T element), but the template Stock class (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java) calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). The solution repository's ArrayHelpers (src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java) defines addElementToArray(...) (matching Stock). Because the problem statement encourages using ArrayHelpers (problem_statement.md), students will try to use the provided helper but find the name mismatch causes a compilation error (no addElementToArray in the template helper) and prevents a clear mapping from the helper suggestion to the actual template code.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the helper method name for adding an element to an array. Rename the template ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) so it matches the usage in Stock.java and the solution, and keeps the problem hint consistent. Alternatively, change the call in Stock.java to ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...), but preferrably rename the template method to addElementToArray(...) to match the solution and avoid confusion.
